title: Drinking Water Notice and Service-Line Coordinator
tagline: Unknown is an inventory state—not permission to invent a safety conclusion.

cards: A resident reasonably asks whether the water is safe.
Material status does not create a health conclusion by itself.
A reassuring answer can suppress required notice and follow-up.
The coordinator proves service steps without deciding safety.

story.headline: The comforting answer hidden inside an unknown pipe
beats: A household asks about an unknown service-line material record.
The address inventory, sample, notice, and assistance systems differ.
Flattening unknown into safe or lead invents a public-health conclusion.
The action chain preserves exact state and routes the accountable authority.
